transcription.content: Good morning Mr Sharma, what brings you in today?
My right shoulder has been aching for about three months.
Did it start after any injury or fall?
No, no injury, it just crept up on me.
Anything that makes it worse? How are you sleeping?
Reaching overhead to write on the board. It wakes me if I lie on that side.
Can you lift your arm out to the side for me?
It hurts partway up, then eases near the top.
That painful arc with your night pain points to a rotator cuff impingement rather than a frozen shoulder. Physiotherapy should settle it and you can keep teaching.
That is a relief, thank you doctor.
